slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: measures
slots.about: id (1..n), key, label, unit (with a leading space, may be empty), better ("up" or "down")

slots.name: records
slots.about: saved: id, date, measure (a key), value (a number)

slots.name: windows
slots.about: id (days in the window), label; first is the default

slots.name: window_prefix
slots.about: before the day count under each number, with a trailing space

slots.name: window_suffix
slots.about: after the day count, with a leading space

slots.name: new_word
slots.about: in the pill when the window before had nothing

slots.name: better_word
slots.about: spoken when the change goes the good way

slots.name: worse_word
slots.about: spoken when it goes the other way

default.shows: every measure's total over the first window, its change against the window before, and one bar per day (last 14 at most)

labels.tile: label, value, change and better_word or worse_word

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, delay, smooth, snappy and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: direction is the arrow icon; good or bad is spoken in words
